主要内容: The Walt Disney Company extended the expiration date of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations for 21CFA Notes from January 15, 2019, to January 28, 2019. The extension is part of the process to adopt proposed amendments to the indentures governing the 21CFA Notes. The Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations are conditioned on the closing of New Disney’s acquisition of 21CF, which may not be waived. The settlement is expected to occur promptly, but at least two business days after the Expiration Date. The Company anticipates providing notice of any such extension before the Expiration Date. If conditions to the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations (excluding the consummation of the Acquisition) are satisfied or waived by the Expiration Date, settlement will occur upon the consummation of the Acquisition. If the Acquisition is not completed, the 21CFA Notes will be returned to the tendering holders. The communication contains forward-looking statements regarding the consummation of the Acquisition, its benefits, and the timing of the Exchange Offers and Consent Solicitations. These statements are subject to risks, including the failure to complete the Acquisition, regulatory approvals, and other uncertainties. The Company also mentioned potential litigation and unforeseen liabilities related to the Acquisition.
